summary: This note is a statistics summary of the college basketball rivalry between the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Duke Blue Devils. It gives the first and latest meetings with scores, the total number of meetings, and the all-time series record. It also lists the largest victories and the longest and current win streaks for each side.
one_line: Statistics overview of the North Carolina Tar Heels versus Duke Blue Devils college basketball rivalry, covering meetings, series record, and streaks.
key_facts: The first meeting between North Carolina and Duke in the rivalry took place on January 24, 1920, and North Carolina won 36-25.
The most recent meeting in the note took place on March 9, 2018, and North Carolina won 74-69.
North Carolina and Duke have met 248 times in total.
In the all-time series, North Carolina leads 137 wins to 111.
North Carolina's largest victory in the rivalry was by 37 points, in 1921.
Duke's largest victory in the rivalry was by 35 points, in 1964.
North Carolina's longest win streak in the rivalry was 16 games, from 1921 to 1928.
North Carolina currently holds a win streak of 1 game in the rivalry.
The sport of the rivalry is college basketball.
North Carolina's team name in the note is the Tar Heels.
Duke's team name in the note is the Blue Devils.
